name: smwmusic-ninja-gaiden-nes-ryu-s-determination-act-4
title: Ninja Gaiden (NES) - Ryu's Determination ~ Act 4-2 (Remix)
description:
A remix of Ryu's Determination ~ Act 4-2 from Ninja Gaiden.

This baby can fit in cavern stages and stages with intense amounts of platforming... like a ninja.

Note:
- There is a "READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- The Thunder SFX & @7 are disabled.

------------------

Another one of my old remixes from a few months back that I regret not uploading earlier. I love this song to death, and I remember having a ton of fun with this remix / port.
